title: No Tears for Pharaoh, and the Tree of Zaqqum

paragraphs.text: When Pharaoh's people were destroyed, neither the heaven nor the earth wept for them, and they were not given any extra time to escape their end. Allah rescued the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment that they suffered under Pharaoh, who was a proud man and one of those who went beyond all limits. With full knowledge, Allah chose the Children of Israel above the worlds, and He gave them many signs, in which there was a clear test for them.

Now the disbelievers among the Prophet's people keep repeating that there is nothing beyond their first death and that they will never be raised again. Then they challenge the Prophet and the believers to bring their forefathers back to life if he is really telling the truth. But are they any better than the people of Tubba' and the nations who came before them? Allah destroyed those peoples, because they were criminals.

Allah did not create the heavens, the earth and everything between them as a game or for amusement. He created them only in truth and for a real purpose, although most people do not understand this. The Day of Judgement is the appointed time for all of them. On that Day no relative will be able to help another relative in the slightest way, and no one will receive any help, except those on whom Allah has mercy. He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

After this, the passage describes the terrible food that awaits the people of Hell. The tree of zaqqum, it says, will be the food of the sinful. That food is like murky, dirty oil, and once the sinful have eaten it, it will boil and churn inside their bellies.

hardWords.m: to ask someone to prove something
